profile.name: Acomo N.V.
profile.summary: Acomo N.V., together with its subsidiaries, engages in sourcing, trading, processing, packaging, and distributing conventional and organic food ingredients and solutions for the food and beverage industry in the Netherlands, Germany, other European countries, North America, and internationally. It operates through five segments: Spices and Nuts, Edible Seeds, Organic Ingredients, Tea, and Food Solutions. The Spices and Nuts segment provides tropical products, including pepper, nutmeg, desiccated coconut, shelled and unshelled nuts, dried fruits, dehydrated vegetables, herbs, rice crackers, and snack products. The Edible Seeds segment trades in, processes, and distributes edible seeds, such as poppy, sesame, pumpkin, and flax, as well as sunflower seeds comprising in-kernel and shelled for the snack and retail industries; birdseeds for wildlife; and edible seeds to bakery, spice, and confectionery industries. The Organic Ingredients segment provides a range of organic food products and ingredients in various categories, including cocoa, coffee, fruit and vegetables, edible seeds, nuts and dried fruits, oils, and juice products. The Tea segment trades in, processes, and distributes through warehouses and blending facilities; and monitors and analyzes market development, and shares insight to customers, which include novel appetites for specialty tea. The Food Solutions segment produces and supplies culinary and functional ingredients, plant-based solutions, wet and dry blends, and spice mixes to food companies; and provides product development, manufacturing, packaging, distribution, and inventory management services. It also sells sunflower products under the SunButter brand name. The company was formerly known as Amsterdam Commodities N.V. and changed its name to Acomo N.V. in June 2022. Acomo N.V. was founded in 1908 and is based in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.
profile.summary_fr: Acomo N.V., avec ses filiales, s’engage dans l’approvisionnement, le commerce, la transformation, l’emballage et la distribution d’ingrédients et de solutions alimentaires conventionnels et biologiques pour l’industrie alimentaire et des boissons aux Pays-Bas, en Allemagne, dans d’autres pays européens, en Amérique du Nord et à l’international. Il opère à travers cinq segments: les épices et les noix, les graines comestibles, les ingrédients biologiques, le thé et les solutions alimentaires. Le segment Épices et noix fournit des produits tropicaux, y compris le poivre, la noix de muscade, la noix de coco desséchée, les noix décortiquées et non décortiquées, les fruits secs, les légumes déshydratés, les herbes, les craquelins de riz et les produits de collation.
